bio.text: Treg Bernt is a Republican member of the Idaho Senate for District 21, listed by the Idaho Legislature as serving a second term and living in Meridian.
According to the legislature biography, Bernt was born and raised in Pocatello, graduated from Idaho State University with a B.A. in speech communication, and is a business owner.
The biography says Bernt has served the Meridian community in several roles since 2007 and was elected twice to the Meridian City Council.
